What the record says

  • The Eagles' best spread spot with at least 30 graded games is road underdog (all time): 174-122-4 against the spread, a 58.8% cover rate.
  • Their weakest is underdog of 3.5 to 6.5 (since 2002): 19-23, 45.2%.
  • On totals since 2002, the over hits most often when the closing number is under 38 (18-13-1, 58.1% over) and least often at 45 to 47.5 (45-59, 43.3%).
  • All time they have covered 51.4% at home and 54.2% on the road, a 2.8 point edge on the road.
